intro: Arugal's Folly is a key quest in the Sepulcher's ongoing campaign against the mad archmage's influence across Silverpine Forest. Dalar Dawnweaver tasks Horde adventurers with infiltrating Deep Elem Mine to execute the corrupted foreman, Grimson the Pale, securing vital mineral wealth for Varimathras's forces.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.
But in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered. It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.
The mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.
I want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale. With his death, the mine shall be ours.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Has Grimson the Pale been slain? Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most excellent. The mine will provide superb resources for our forces as we spread throughout Silverpine and into Azeroth.
